subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Exchange partner universities are pairs of institutions that form formal agreements to facilitate student exchange and academic collaboration.
• Previously known as "academic partnership programs," the concept of exchange partnerships evolved in Europe after the fall of the Berlin Wall as a way to strengthen educational ties.
• Many universities in California maintain such partnerships with institutions around the world.
• Oakmont University in California and Technical University of Munich, Germany, became exchange partners in 1995.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize the duration of Oakmont University and Technical University of Munich's exchange partnership. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Since the fall of the Berlin Wall, exchange partners such as Oakmont University in California and Technical University of Munich, Germany, have continued to form educational partnerships to facilitate academic collaboration.
choices.B: Despite their distance from each other, the exchange partner universities of Oakmont University in California and Technical University of Munich, Germany have enjoyed the same partnership as many other exchange institutions.
choices.C: Technical University of Munich, which in 1995 became an exchange partner—or "academic partnership"—to Oakmont University in California, is located in Germany.
choices.D: As exchange partner universities, Oakmont University in California and Technical University of Munich, Germany, have engaged in student exchange and collaboration since 1995.

explanation: Choice D is the best answer because it most effectively emphasizes the duration of the partnership through its use of 'since 1995.' The word 'since' specifically indicates ongoing action from a past starting point to the present, implying that the partnership has continued for nearly three decades. The phrase 'have engaged in student exchange and collaboration since 1995' combines present perfect tense with the temporal marker to emphasize both the partnership's establishment date and its sustained continuation, directly accomplishing the goal of highlighting duration.
